sharedCoverGroups.recommendedAction: Keep the full styling photograph on the existing outfit product. Replace each accessory cover and gallery with its own generated item-only photo, preserving accessory IDs and current prices. Keep outfit markers linked to those same IDs. Remove outfit-only marker coordinates from accessory packshot records.

implementationNotes: The current shared-image issue can be fixed through asset and product-record updates; no frontend grouping or schema change is required.
Do not collapse physically separate bag, shoes and scarf records into one SKU; preserving IDs keeps existing marker links, saved bags, bookmarks and stock references valid.
Preserve accessory-specific color_key values so reused styling photographs do not inherit outfit color presets.
Do not hide or merge arbitrary products simply because titles or image paths match; replacing the incorrect accessory images resolves the observed duplicate outfit cards.
If the user confirms every outfit should be split into individual items, that is a separate broader generation/mapping pass across the remaining distinct outfit photographs.
